title: The Island of Last Things
description: A SOARING, PROPULSIVE, AND UNFORGETTABLEnovel about two zookeepers at the last zoo in the world Sometimes a new author will sidle up and whisper in your ear, and sometimes she’ll grab you by the neck. Emma Sloley is in the latter camp. ―Rebecca MakkaiCamille has always preferred animals to people.
